titleText: Two accused of stealing car batteries from eCabs garage
mainText: From Times of Malta: Two accused of stealing car batteries from eCabs garage. Man remanded in custody, woman granted bail over alleged €400 theft in St Julian’s

titleText: Too early to rule on Fenech’s fair trial claim over Theuma pardon, judge says
mainText: From Times of Malta: Too early to rule on Fenech’s fair trial claim over Theuma pardon, judge says. Court cites pending appeals as it declines to consider his claims at this stage

titleText: Robert Abela calls for fair EU budget deal, with adequate funding for Cohesion Policy
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Robert Abela calls for fair EU budget deal, with adequate funding for Cohesion Policy. Prime Minister Robert Abela has called for a fair agreement on the European Union's 2028-2034 budget, stressing the need to maintain adequate funding for Cohesion Policy while taking into account the different circumstances of member states.

titleText: Massive 122-unit block in Nigret approved by Planning Authority
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Massive 122-unit block in Nigret approved by Planning Authority. A large-scale 122-unit residential project in the Nigret area of Żurrieq has been given the green light by the Planning Authority (PA). The permit was passed with near-total consensus, with environmental NGO representative Romano Cassar casting the sole dissenting vote.

titleText: PN calls for urgent talks after higher hotel licence fees announced without consultation
mainText: From MaltaToday: PN calls for urgent talks after higher hotel licence fees announced without consultation. The Nationalist Party has called for urgent talks with tourism operators after the government announced higher hotel licence fees without what the party called proper consultation.
